provenance.paper_title: LongVideoAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning with Long Videos

evidence.paraphrase: Grounding agent outputs (segment localizations) and vision agent outputs (textual observations) accumulated by the master agent. iterative retrieval of sparse, question-relevant evidence via the grounding agent; subtitles complemented with visual detail from the vision agent.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): The full-paper lifecycle review found question-relevant video segments fixed during downstream inference; query-conditioned access, preprocessing, or training-time changes were not counted as persistent deployed updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
